full_corpus_runs_required: once after all affected slices and boundary controls pass
calibration_budget.when_exhausted: Stop without sealing. Emit an insufficiency diagnostic and obtain human authorization before changing observability, protocol, fixtures or scope. Exhaustion is Unknown, earns no mutation credit and never lowers the required score.

campaign.execution_authority: independent R3 preseal verifier; adversary re-chained metadata without rebuilding
campaign.vector_comparison: Compare classifications, parsed public values, diagnostics and inventory deltas. Any order dependence, missing receipt or non-deliberate Unknown blocks preseal.

catalog_policy.mechanical_controls: Each E01-E06 control is a positive equivalence case. It must remain Preserved independently of the negative mutant recipes; these controls prevent the discriminator from treating excluded implementation mechanics as language observables.
catalog_policy.negative_mutant: A provenance-valid, buildable and executable transformation that preserves the declared collateral controls while contradicting at least one frozen P1461 language obligation.
semantic_validity_gate: the mutant is applied only to an isolated copy derived from the causal baseline or a later integration fixture authorized by preseal
the exact mutation recipe and resulting source hash are recorded
the mutant builds without changing protected inputs
the pinned command, profile and binary identity are unambiguous
the declared witness reaches a parseable public observation rather than failing from infrastructure or unrelated code
catalog_policy.unknown_no_credit: Unknown never counts as Violated or Preserved. A required mutant that is unbuildable, opaque, non-reproducible, over budget or provenance-invalid remains an unmet required mutant; it may not be silently removed from the denominator.

m02_executor_correction.note: The first producer smoke query was inconsistent with its expected value. The exact M02 source and isolated binary were retained; the corrected direct probe confirmed the concrete None mutation before the campaign continued.

mechanical_equivalence_controls.mechanical_variant: Change Scope storage allocation, capacity or internal traversal without changing lookup results, diagnostics or inventory paths.
mechanical_equivalence_controls.reason: Scope memory layout, capacity and internal collection mechanics are excluded.

mechanical_equivalence_controls.mechanical_variant: Apply formatting, comments or equivalent import/reexport spelling that leaves ownership, visibility, architecture gates and all C01-C10 observations unchanged.
mechanical_equivalence_controls.reason: Rust source presentation is excluded except where an architectural gate independently constrains it.

no protected input changes
